title: Universal AI access architecture and transport contract
objective: Ratify the provider-neutral Cotra v0.2 architecture before runtime work: define local stdio and loopback Streamable HTTP modes, remote relay/web mode, device identity and pairing, OAuth and remote principal boundaries, provider compatibility constraints, tool-surface profiles, Desktop Commander replacement scope, zero-cost/self-host requirements, the universal-connectivity threat model, and an ordered P14-P17 delivery sequence without changing runtime authority.

include: docs/canonical/UNIVERSAL_AI_ACCESS_PLAN.md as the implementation-ready provider-neutral architecture and P14-P17 delivery plan

docs/security/UNIVERSAL_CONNECTIVITY_THREAT_MODEL.md covering remote identity, OAuth, pairing, device routing, relay replay/reordering, loopback DNS rebinding, privacy/logging, quota exhaustion, cross-provider isolation, protected-surface regressions, and executable-registry widening
docs/research/UNIVERSAL_CLIENT_COMPATIBILITY.md recording current official ChatGPT/Codex, Claude, Mistral, MCP, and reference free-relay constraints with a dated re-verification rule
an explicit decision that Desktop Commander is not a dependency, fallback, transport, or qualification component
an explicit decision that OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel becomes one optional provider adapter rather than Cotra's universal architecture dependency
an explicit implementation order preventing remote relay code before transport-neutral local contracts and preventing MCP authority widening before a canonical parity inventory
exclude: device key generation or pairing implementation
any claim that ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral, or Codex integration is already proven

authority_delta.network: None; no listener, relay, or provider connection is introduced by this grain.

invariants: cotrad remains the local policy and authority kernel
remote providers, relay infrastructure, and MCP transports cannot mint local approval or workspace trust
Desktop Commander is not required for any target Cotra path
local Cotra use remains possible without a hosted Cotra control plane
a public shared relay is never represented as provider-to-device end-to-end encrypted unless the transport actually establishes that property
no generic executor, raw shell, arbitrary proxy, or remote approval delegation is authorized by architecture planning
provider availability and directory approval are external facts that cannot be claimed without evidence

acceptance.claim: The universal access plan defines local stdio, loopback Streamable HTTP, and remote web/relay topologies with explicit trust boundaries and keeps cotrad/local approval authoritative.

The plan defines device identity, pairing, rotation/revocation, remote principal/session fields, OAuth 2.1 requirements, relay routing/replay/backpressure/offline semantics, and typed transport failures before implementation is authorized.

The universal-connectivity threat model covers cross-tenant routing, auth mix-up, token replay/revocation, pairing theft, session fixation, relay replay/reordering, route substitution, offline mutation, reconnect drift, DNS rebinding, plaintext/log leakage, wrong-principal delivery, prompt-injection exfiltration, proxy abuse, quota exhaustion, executable-registry widening, and supply chain risk with planned controls and qualification requirements.

The compatibility matrix is grounded in current official provider/MCP documentation and distinguishes local versus remote requirements, including the fact that public ChatGPT availability requires external plugin review/publication and can vary by account/region/surface.

The zero-cost design preserves fully local/self-hosted modes, prohibits automatic paid overflow, and treats any community relay as optional convenience with explicit quotas rather than a mandatory founder-funded control plane.

The plan includes a separate, ordered Desktop Commander replacement program that requires a parity inventory and retains deliberate denials for unrestricted shell, PowerShell, generic sockets, elevation, remote approval, and arbitrary filesystem authority.

The P14-P17 grain ordering is implementation-ready and prevents remote network authority, tool-surface widening, and provider publication from preceding their required architecture/security predecessors.

Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev semantic review, Alibaba Open Code Review where integrated, manual review of excluded files, security review, and zero unresolved blocking review threads all pass for the planning diff before merge.

successor_requirements.sg_000048: May begin only after SG-000047 closes canonically. It must extract a transport-neutral MCP server/tool registry without changing the existing v0.1 public tool set or local authority.

done_when: The universal-access architecture, threat model, provider compatibility matrix, zero-cost deployment rule, Desktop Commander replacement scope, and P14-P17 implementation ordering are reviewed and canonical with no runtime authority change.
